newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Hewlett-Packard firms.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Hewlett-Packard firms.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co shares were active at 50-1/4 preceding Tuesday's market open, rising 1/8 from yesterday's regular market close and reversing Monday's after-hours decline to 49-1/2.
After the NYSE close Monday, the company reported fiscal fourth quarter earnings slightly below analysts' expectations.
Hewlett-Packard posted earnings of $0.62 per share, $0.02 short of the consensus forecast.
Revenues for the period rose to $10.15 billion from $9.05 billion one year ago.
A trio of stock suffered before the open after Goldman Sachs moved the issues from the firm's priority list to the recommended list, according to market sources.
The declining issues are Altera Corp, off 1-3/4 to 65-1/2, PictureTel Corp, off 5/8 to 29-3/4 and Linear Technology Corp, which fell to 39-3/4 from 41-3/8.
